description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various categories related to language model capabilities, with a total of 10 slices. The categories are labeled as follows: Multitasking (dark teal, approximately 21%), Context Retrieving (teal, approximately 16%), Dynamic Instruction (light teal, approximately 13%), Memorization (light blue, approximately 13%), Dynamic Environment (blue, approximately 13%), Context Tracking (dark blue, approximately 13%), Recursive Reasoning (lighter blue, approximately 15%), Triggering (lightest blue, approximately 13%), Personalization (light red, approximately 13%), and Contradiction Resolution (red, approximately 15%), with Privacy Protection (gray, approximately 15%) being partially obscured. The chart does not include a legend, but labels are provided outside the chart for each slice, along with numerical values. The slices are visually distinct due to their different colors, and some slices have similar sizes, while others vary. The chart appears to be arranged in a somewhat clockwise order by color, transitioning from red to teal to blue.
